messages:
alex: Quick note - obsidian-ranker-v2 PTQ int4 smoke: ndcg@10 improved but mrr@1 dropped on holdout_v3. anyone seen this pattern?

maya: That usually smells like tie/collapse after quantization. Did you keep candidate ordering and dedupe identical?

alex: yes. repro cmd: python eval_rerank.py --model obsidian-v2-int4 --candidates candidates_v1.jsonl --holdout holdout_v3 --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@1 --seed 42

jorge: share top-k stats (r1-r2 gap, fraction ties). tiny gaps kill mrr.

alex: quick stats: r1-r2 mean gap 0.0012, frac top ties 0.018.

liz: 1.8% ties is suspicious. what PTQ recipe?

alex: per-channel asymmetric, no bias-correction, quantlib-v0.9.

maya: two quick ablations: (A) per-tensor symmetric on final linear, (B) add bias-correction pass on final layer. also try candidate shuffle.

alex: ran ablations. summary: fp16 ndcg@10 0.412 mrr@1 0.273; int4-default ndcg@10 0.424 mrr@1 0.262; int4-bias-corr last ndcg@10 0.419 mrr@1 0.271.

jorge: bias-corr almost recovers mrr, nice. check slices head/mid/tail - tail often hits worst.

alex: tail mrr improved from 0.177->0.205 with bias-corr.

liz: action items: make bias-corr default in conversion, add per-slice metrics to onboarding CI, run a 48h 5% shadow canary with auto-rollback if mrr drops >2% over 6h.

maya: i'll create the canary config. alex please open PR for quant change and add slice outputs.

alex: will do, posting PR link here when ready. thanks!
